_comment: Rows whose store Arabic title is a word-for-word machine translation of a brand's product name. For each id listed under arShowsStoreEnglish the Arabic page shows the store's own English title (name_en) instead of its Arabic one. Nothing is translated. A row is added only on Mahmoud's word, by a landing; a refresh never edits this file. Rule of 23 Nov 2026 (Mahmoud: «yes for both»).

arShowsStoreEnglish.amazon:B07MMK6SY9: Amazon's Arabic title «جوجل - زجاج اكسبلورر 2.0» reads Glass, the product name, as the material. Mahmoud, 23 Nov 2026.
